difference: الإخفاء: the نون is hidden before 15 letters and the next letter has no شدة. الإدغام بغنة: the نون merges into ي ن م و and the next letter takes a شدة.
Before ب the نون becomes a hidden ميم on the lips (الإقلاب); before the other 15 letters it is hidden toward that letter's place (الإخفاء).
A مْ before ب is hidden with a held غنة; before any letter other than ب and م it is said clearly with no held غنة.
Both are a مّ with a 2-count غنة. الإدغام الشفوي is made from a مْ meeting a م across two words; الغنة المشددة is any نّ or مّ already written with a شدة.
Into ي ن م و the نون merges with a غنة; into ل and ر it merges with no غنة (حفص من طريق الشاطبية).
Across two words a نون before ي ن م و merges; inside one word (دُنْيَا، بُنْيَٰنٌ، صِنْوَانٌ، قِنْوَانٌ) it stays clear (الإظهار المطلق), as it does before a throat letter (الإظهار الحلقي).
The ل of ال is said before ابْغِ حَجَّكَ وَخَفْ عَقِيمَهُ (القمرية); before the other 14 letters it is silent and the next letter takes a شدة (الشمسية).
The ل of the name اللَّه is heavy after فتحة or ضمة or at the start, and light after any كسرة.
Look at the ر's own vowel: فتحة or ضمة is heavy, كسرة is light. With سكون, look at the letter before it (and, after a كسرة, at a heavy letter after it).
The قلقلة letter has a سكون in the middle or while you keep reading (الصغرى), or you stop on it at the end of a word (الكبرى, stronger).
The همزة is in the same word as the حرف مد (المتصل, obligatory) or starts the next word (المنفصل, permitted). In حفص من الشاطبية both are 4 or 5, read equal.
The سكون after the حرف مد comes only from stopping (العارض: 2, 4 or 6) or is part of the word, usually a شدة (اللازم: always 6).
Before the stopped letter there is a وْ or يْ after a فتحة (اللين), or a true حرف مد (العارض). When both come in one recitation, اللين may not be longer than العارض.
The pronoun هـ stretched before a word that does not start with a همزة is 2 counts (الصغرى); before a همزة it is 4 or 5, like المنفصل (الكبرى).
The همزة comes before the حرف مد (البدل, 2 counts in حفص) or after it in the same word (المتصل, 4 or 5).
المد الطبيعي is a written حرف مد; مد العوض is the alif that replaces تنوين الفتح only when you stop. Both are 2 counts.
The same letter twice (المثلين) or two letters from the same مخرج with different qualities, such as د and ت (المتجانسين).
Same مخرج (المتجانسين: ت ط، د ت، ذ ظ، ث ذ، ب م) or close مخارج (المتقاربين: ل ر، ق ك).
The same letter twice, as in هَل لَّكَ (المثلين), or two close letters, as in قُل رَّبِّ (المتقاربين).
